'''2012 Worlds Day 2 Rolf Wachsmuth DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Rolf Wachsmuth]] at [[2012 World Championship]] (Day 2).

* '''Player:''' [[Rolf Wachsmuth]]
* '''Event:''' [[2012 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]

* '''Stage:''' Day 2
